commentary.text: 90+7' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+5' 5 - 3 A perfectly taken corner kick. Abdon Prats (Mallorca) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the top right corner, increasing the score of today's match – 5:3.
90+5' Mallorca force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+1' Matija Nastasic (Mallorca) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' 5 - 2 Goal 5:2! Abdon Prats (Mallorca) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
86' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is flagged for offside.

84' What a save from Paulo Gazzaniga! Abdon Prats (Mallorca) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
82' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header!
81' The ball is out of play and Girona manage to earn a corner.
79' Ivan Martin (Girona) sees a yellow card from Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
78' A substitution has been made. Samu Costa is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
78' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vedat Muriqi.
76' Michel prepares a substitution. Savio is replaced by Pablo Torre (Girona).
75' Substitution. Yangel Herrera makes way for Valery (Girona).
74' Savio is the provider with a good cross and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he fires a shot well wide of the right post.
71' Yan Couto (Girona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
70' Yan Couto (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
69' Aleix Garcia (Girona) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Predrag Rajkovic is alert and makes a decent save.
67' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
65' Here comes a substitution. Eric Garcia is given a rest as he is replaced by Juanpe (Girona).
65' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Manu Morlanes will be replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Toni Lato (Mallorca) will replace Jaume Costa.
65' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' Here is a change. Viktor Tsygankov is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Portu (Girona).
62' It is time for a substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is on for Artem Dovbyk.
57' 5 - 1 Savio (Girona) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
52' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) meets an accurate cross in the box and steers a fine header towards the net. The goalkeeper has to react quickly to keep the ball out.
48' Girona quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
48' Yan Couto (Girona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Girona earn a corner.
46' Substitution. Siebe Van Der Heyden will be replaced by Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+10' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+8' Aleix Garcia (Girona) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
45+4' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for an infringement.
45+4' Yangel Herrera (Girona) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
45' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 4 - 1 Goal! Yangel Herrera (Girona) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Predrag Rajkovic is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 4:1.
39' Javier Aguirre is stunned as referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
38' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
38' 3 - 1 Goal! Savio shows great vision to find Ivan Martin (Girona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 3:1.
35' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Savio (Girona) heads on.
33' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is booked.
33' 2 - 1 Artem Dovbyk (Girona) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the bottom right corner, ricocheting in off the post. Predrag Rajkovic was helpless.
32' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
31' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
31' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) picks up a yellow card.
31' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
31' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
31' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Girona. Let’s see what happens!
30' One of the Girona players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! David Lopez (Girona) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:1.
25' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Girona are awarded a free kick.
22' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
22' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
21' Daley Blind (Girona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
20' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
18' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Savio (Girona) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Predrag Rajkovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
15' Mallorca take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

14' The ball is cleared after Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the left post.
10' Girona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
6' Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows for a foul after Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Paulo Gazzaniga into the bottom left corner.
4' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
4' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Javier Aguirre (Mallorca) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
2' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Girona will have the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
